effect.u_message: Acidic Discharge - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 3, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 2, leg_r 2.  A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges acid into your muscles, causing sharp pain and minor damage.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Active Defense System - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 1 kJ.  Power: running cost 1 kJ.  Power: trigger cost 10 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 10, head 1, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 2, leg_r 2.  A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  Everything loses velocity when penetrating this field, which results in reduced amount of dealt damage at the cost of your bionic energy.  Bullets and stabbing attacks will lose more velocity than cutting attacks and those in turn more than bashing attacks.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Adrenaline Pump - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 5 J.  Uses slots: torso 4.  A stimulator system has been surgically implanted alongside your adrenal glands, allowing you to trigger your body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Advanced cyber arm (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 4.  A advanced cyber arm replacing your left arm.  Uses 4 of the 6 points in the left arm; +1 Strength, +1 Dexterity; absorbs damage at quality 85%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Advanced cyber arm (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 4.  A advanced cyber arm replacing your right arm.  Uses 4 of the 6 points in the right arm; +1 Strength, +1 Dexterity; absorbs damage at quality 85%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Advanced cyber leg (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 6.  A advanced cyber leg replacing your left leg.  Uses 6 of the 10 points in the left leg; +1 Dexterity, +1 Strength; absorbs damage at quality 85%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Advanced cyber leg (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_r 6.  A advanced cyber leg replacing your right leg.  Uses 6 of the 10 points in the right leg; +1 Dexterity, +1 Strength; absorbs damage at quality 85%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Aero-Evaporator - toggled implant.  Power: running cost 60 J.  Uses slots: torso 5.  This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which slowly trickles directly into your blood stream.  It may fail in very dry environments.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Air Filtration System - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 5, mouth 1.  Surgically implanted in your trachea is an advanced filtration system.  If toxins or airborne diseases find their way into your windpipe, the filter will attempt to remove them.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Alarm System - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 1 J.  Power: running cost 1 J.  Power: trigger cost 5 J.  Uses slots: torso 2, head 1.  A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert you.  This is very useful during sleep, or if you suspect a cloaked pursuer.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Anti-Glare Compensators - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  Your eyes have quick-reacting transition lenses surgically installed over them.  They negate glare penalties, partially protect you from bright flashes, and protect your eyes when welding.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Artificial Night Generator - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 9 kJ.  Power: running cost 9 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 16.  When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 2 tile radius through destructive interference.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

AudioVox - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 3, mouth 2.  Hailing from a world choked with neon smog, and appreciated by Exodii artists, the AudioVox implant allows you to change, remodulate, and even autotune your voice.  It also causes vocalizations /(such as shouts and singing/) to be much louder.  It consists of an electronic voice box, synthetic larynx and multiple speakers implanted throughout your throat.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Autonomous Surgical Scalpels - toggled implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 2, arm_l 2.  A system of surgical grade scalpels is implanted in your forearms, extending from just above your wrists.  They allow you to make automated precise cuts and can also be used as a high-quality butchering tool.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Basic cyber arm (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 5.  A basic cyber arm replacing your left arm.  Uses 5 of the 6 points in the left arm; +1 Strength; absorbs damage at quality 70%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Basic cyber arm (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 5.  A basic cyber arm replacing your right arm.  Uses 5 of the 6 points in the right arm; +1 Strength; absorbs damage at quality 70%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Basic cyber leg (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 8.  A basic cyber leg replacing your left leg.  Uses 8 of the 10 points in the left leg; +1 Dexterity; absorbs damage at quality 70%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Basic cyber leg (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_r 8.  A basic cyber leg replacing your right leg.  Uses 8 of the 10 points in the right leg; +1 Dexterity; absorbs damage at quality 70%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Battery System - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 20.  You have a battery draining attachment, and thus can make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.  Use bionic menu to drain charge from a battery.  Can be toggled on and off at will.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Bionic Claws - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 25 J.  Uses slots: hand_l 4, hand_r 4.  Vicious claws have been surgically installed inside your fingers, allowing you to extend and retract them at the cost of a small amount of power.  These do considerable cutting damage, but prevent you from holding anything else while extended.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Bionic Nostril - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 2, mouth 1.  You're really not sure how the CBM ended up in your nose, but no matter how it got there this badly misplaced bionic makes it difficult to breathe.  Increases mouth encumbrance by ten.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Bionic Short Circuit - passive implant.  Power: trigger cost 25 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 1, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, leg_l 3, leg_r 3.  A poorly-wired bionic which fails to serve its intended purpose, this malfunctioning device periodically short-circuits, causing systemic muscle tremors.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Bionic Visual Impairment - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  Due to a badly misplaced dielectric stylette, you are now suffering from mild optic neuropathy.  Increases eye encumbrance by ten.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Bionic-Induced Deformity - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 4, mouth 1.  A combination of poor surgical installation and unpleasant scarring has lead to the malfunctioning bionic catastrophe you call your face.  People who mind that you look like a dime-store Frankenstein will react poorly to your appearance.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Blood Analysis - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 100 J.  Uses slots: torso 4.  Small sensors have been surgically implanted in your heart, allowing you to analyze your blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Blood Filter - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 600 J.  Uses slots: torso 5.  A filtration system near your heart allows you to actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs.  It will have limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in your system will be affected.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Cable Charger System - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 7.  You have a complex port surgically mounted above your hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a power source via jumper cable.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Calorie Tracker - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 1.  A module implanted in your body measures your calorie intake and expenditure at all times.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Cerebral Booster - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 6.  Your brain has been enhanced with bionic coprocessors, giving you a +2 bonus to intelligence.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Chain Lightning - activated implant.  Uses slots: torso 16, arm_l 4.  Your body is equipped with a chain lightning generator, allowing you to emit a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake, jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Cloaking System - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 30 kJ.  Power: running cost 30 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 8, head 2, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, hand_l 1, hand_r 1, leg_l 4, leg_r 4, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  This high-power system uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make you blend into your background, rendering you fully invisible to normal vision.  However, you may be detected by infrared, sonar, etc.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Close Quarters Battle - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 20 J.  Power: running cost 20 J.  Uses slots: head 3.  Bionic processors and databanks, loaded with martial arts combat programs, are surgically integrated into your nervous system.  While active, the CQB module will improve your hand-to-hand combat skills, but prevents you from improving them through combat experience.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Concealed arm gun (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 3.  A power-fed pistol folded inside the left forearm.  Activate it to raise the gun; it fires bullets using bionic power.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the arm.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Concealed arm gun (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 3.  A power-fed pistol folded inside the right forearm.  Activate it to raise the gun; it fires bullets using bionic power.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the arm.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Cortical coprocessor - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 2.  Cortical coprocessor: a cranial implant that gives +1 Intelligence.  Uses 2 of the 8 points in the head.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Cortical coprocessor II - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3.  Cortical coprocessor II: a cranial implant that gives +2 Intelligence.  Uses 3 of the 8 points in the head.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Cortical coprocessor III - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 4.  Cortical coprocessor III: a cranial implant that gives +3 Intelligence.  Uses 4 of the 8 points in the head.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Cranial Flashlight - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 2 J.  Power: running cost 2 J.  Uses slots: head 1.  Surgically mounted between your eyes is a small but powerful LED flashlight.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Cyberbrain Mk I - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3.  A cyberbrain interfaced with your nervous system.  Control Value limit 4.  Required to run nanohacks.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Cyberstomach - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 4.  A synthetic stomach that turns food into bionic power (toggle it on) and lets you eat cyber rations, which an ordinary stomach cannot digest.  Uses 4 of the 24 points in the torso.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.
Diamond Cornea - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  Your vision is greatly enhanced, giving you a +2 bonus to perception.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Dielectric Capacitance System - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 5 J.  Power: running cost 5 J.  Uses slots: torso 8, head 2, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, hand_l 1, hand_r 1, leg_l 3, leg_r 3, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  Throughout your body lies a network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors which can be charged with bionic power to temporarily protect you from external electrical discharge.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Directional EMP - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 50 kJ.  Uses slots: arm_l 6, hand_l 1.  Surgically mounted in your left arm and the palm of your left hand are small parabolic EMP field generators.  You may use power to fire a wide but short-ranged blast that will disable electronics and robots.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Electrical Discharge - passive implant.  Power: trigger cost 10 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 6.  A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges electricity through your body, causing pain and brief paralysis but no damage.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Electrical Drain - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 2.  A malfunctioning bionic.  It doesn't perform any useful function, but will occasionally draw power from your batteries.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Electromagnetic Leak - passive implant.  Adds -25 kJ of power capacity.  A broken implant that sends electromagnetic impulses that reduce other implants capacity to store charge.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Electromagnetic Unit - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 15 kJ.  Uses slots: arm_l 9.  Surgically embedded in your left arm is a powerful electromagnet, allowing you to use your own strength to pull all nearby magnetic objects towards you.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Electroshock Unit - toggled implant.  Power: trigger cost 2 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 8, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, hand_l 1, hand_r 1.  While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock your opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Elite cyber arm (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 3.  A elite cyber arm replacing your left arm.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the left arm; +2 Strength, +1 Dexterity; absorbs damage at quality 100%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Elite cyber arm (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 3.  A elite cyber arm replacing your right arm.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the right arm; +2 Strength, +1 Dexterity; absorbs damage at quality 100%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Elite cyber leg (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 5.  A elite cyber leg replacing your left leg.  Uses 5 of the 10 points in the left leg; +2 Dexterity, +1 Strength; absorbs damage at quality 100%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Elite cyber leg (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_r 5.  A elite cyber leg replacing your right leg.  Uses 5 of the 10 points in the right leg; +2 Dexterity, +1 Strength; absorbs damage at quality 100%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

EMP Projector - activated implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 8, hand_r 2.  A ranged EMP generator system is implanted in your right arm and the palm of your right hand.  The system fires precise, single-target pulses that require time to aim.  Extremely effective against electronic targets but mostly useless otherwise.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Endocrine Enervator - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 2.  Through a combination of psychochemical manipulation and old fashioned electrical nerve stimulation, this malfunctioning bionic alters your brain chemistry in such a way as to cause sleepiness.  You will find yourself tiring a bit faster than before.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Enhanced Hearing - toggled implant.  Uses slots: head 2.  When this bionic is active, your hearing will be drastically improved, allowing you to hear ten times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage your hearing.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Enhanced Memory Banks - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 2 J.  Power: running cost 2 J.  Power: trigger cost 25 J.  Uses slots: head 3.  Your memory has been enhanced with small quantum storage drives.  While active, you learn - both through reading and practice - more quickly.  Additionally, you forget skills you've learned slower.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.
Ethanol Burner - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 20.  You burn alcohol as fuel in an extremely efficient reaction.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Expanded Digestive System - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 20.  You have been outfitted with three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines.  Not only can you extract much more nutrition from food, but you are highly resistant to foodborne illness, and can sometimes eat rotten food.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Facial Distortion - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3, mouth 1.  Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, you are capable of altering your facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Finger Lighter - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 1500 J.  Uses slots: hand_l 1.  The index finger of your left hand has a fire starter that can extend from the tip.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Finger-Mounted Laser - activated implant.  Uses slots: hand_r 1.  One of your fingers has a small high-powered laser surgically embedded in it.  This long range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Fingerhack - toggled implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 1.  One of your fingers has an electrohack surgically embedded in it; an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like (but not computers).  Skill in computers is important, and a failed use may damage your circuits.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Fingerpick - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 50 J.  Uses slots: hand_l 2.  One of your fingers has an electronic lockpick surgically embedded in it.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Fingertip Razors - passive implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 1, hand_r 1.  You possess razor-sharp claws underneath your fingernails that do a small amount of unarmed slashing damage whenever your fingertips are uncovered.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Flashbang Generator - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 10 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 18, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, leg_l 3, leg_r 3.  Light emitting diodes surgically integrated into your skin can release a flash comparable to a flashbang grenade, blinding nearby enemies.  Speakers integrated into your body mimic the loud sound, deafening those nearby.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Gasoline Fuel Cell - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 8.  A small gasoline fuel cell fixed to your scapula.  Despite its limited energy output compared to other fuel cells, this device still produces a significant amount of heat dissipated through a heat exhaust protruding from your back.  A diffuse network of bio-plastic bladders has been meshed with your circulatory system and serves as a fuel tank.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Glowy Thing - passive implant.  Power: trigger cost 1 kJ.  You don't think that capacitor is *meant* to glow, but it does, and usually at bad times.  A malfunctioning bionic randomly turns on and off, causing you to glow and making you visible in the dark without improving how much you can see in the slightest.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Heat Drain - toggled implant.  Power: trigger cost 3 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 6, head 3, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, hand_l 1, hand_r 1, leg_l 5, leg_r 5, foot_l 2, foot_r 2.  While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage, and increasing your power reserves slightly.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Heavy dermal plating (head) - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the head: +8 bullet armor and +4 against blows and blades.  Uses 3 of the 8 points in the head; only one plating fits per body part.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Heavy dermal plating (left arm) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 3.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the left arm: +8 bullet armor and +4 against blows and blades.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the left arm; only one plating fits per body part.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Heavy dermal plating (left leg) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 5.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the left leg: +8 bullet armor and +4 against blows and blades.  Uses 5 of the 10 points in the left leg; only one plating fits per body part.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Heavy dermal plating (right arm) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 3.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the right arm: +8 bullet armor and +4 against blows and blades.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the right arm; only one plating fits per body part.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Heavy dermal plating (right leg) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_r 5.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the right leg: +8 bullet armor and +4 against blows and blades.  Uses 5 of the 10 points in the right leg; only one plating fits per body part.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Heavy dermal plating (torso) - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 8.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the torso: +11 bullet armor and +5 against blows and blades.  Uses 8 of the 24 points in the torso; only one plating fits per body part.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Hydraulic Muscles - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 10 kJ.  Power: running cost 10 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 10, arm_l 8, arm_r 8, leg_l 10, leg_r 10.  While activated, your muscles will be greatly enhanced, increasing your strength by 20.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Implanted Night Vision - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 10 J.  Power: running cost 10 J.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  When active, this bionic will amplify existing light, allowing you to see in the dark.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Infolink - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 2.  A compact communications device has been built into your ears, enabling you to communicate over radio waves.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Infrared Vision - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 5 J.  Power: running cost 5 J.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  Your range of vision extends into the infrared, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark or through smoke.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Integrated AR System - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  Extremely thin lenses provide user with augmented reality overlay allowing the user to zoom, and it displays handy information about local topology.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Integrated Circuitry Toolset - passive implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 2, hand_r 2.  Your fingers and arms have been implanted a soldering iron, a multimeter, and a set of small screwdrivers, providing all the tools required for working with bench-scale electrical circuits.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Integrated Dosimeter - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 100 J.  Uses slots: torso 2, head 1, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 1, leg_r 1.  Small radiation sensors have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to analyze your level of absorbed radiation.  They will also alert you whenever exposed to environmental radiation.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Integrated Multimeter - passive implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 1, hand_r 1.  Your fingers and arms have been implanted with retractable electrical probes connected to a multimeter embedded in your arm, allowing you to measure electrical voltage, resistance, and current by touch.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Integrated Multitool - passive implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 2, hand_r 2, arm_l 2, arm_r 2.  Surgically implanted in your hands and forearms is a set of compact tools and a welder that runs off your internal power banks.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Internal Chronometer - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 1.  You have been equipped with an internal atomic clock, ensuring that you will always know the current time.  Additionally, it includes a silent alarm clock function.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Internal Climate Control - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 100 J.  Power: running cost 100 J.  Uses slots: torso 8, head 2, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, hand_l 1, hand_r 1, leg_l 3, leg_r 3, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  Throughout your body lies a network of thermal piping, which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures when activated.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Intravenous Needletip - passive implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 1.  The flesh of the inside of your middle finger has been replaced with a tube leading into your arteries, with a retractable needle extending out of the tip of the finger when clenched.  This lets you pump intravenous drugs like morphine directly into your bloodstream without needing to carry a syringe.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Itchy Metal Thing - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 3, head 2.  A bionic of some sort, so badly installed that you cannot even tell what it was originally supposed to be.  Sometimes it itches horribly.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Joint Servo - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 5 J.  Power: trigger cost 35 J.  Uses slots: leg_l 12, leg_r 12.  Your leg joints have been equipped with servomotors that provide power-assisted movement.  Movement takes less effort when this bionic is online. Wire-Induced Stiffness - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 2, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 1, leg_r 1, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  Improperly installed wires cause a physical stiffness in most of your body, causing increased encumbrance.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Wired Reflexes - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3, torso 6, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, leg_l 7, leg_r 7.  Your reaction time has been greatly enhanced with bionic nerve stimulators, giving you a +2 bonus to dexterity.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

Wrist blade (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 3.  A monomolecular blade that slides out of the right wrist.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the arm.  Status: installed.  Use the bionics screen (})  to switch it on or off.

descriptions: Implant points used in each part of your body, and the condition of the implants.

Acidic Discharge - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 3, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 2, leg_r 2.  A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges acid into your muscles, causing sharp pain and minor damage.

Active Defense System - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 1 kJ.  Power: running cost 1 kJ.  Power: trigger cost 10 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 10, head 1, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 2, leg_r 2.  A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  Everything loses velocity when penetrating this field, which results in reduced amount of dealt damage at the cost of your bionic energy.  Bullets and stabbing attacks will lose more velocity than cutting attacks and those in turn more than bashing attacks.

Adrenaline Pump - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 5 J.  Uses slots: torso 4.  A stimulator system has been surgically implanted alongside your adrenal glands, allowing you to trigger your body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.

Advanced cyber arm (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 4.  A advanced cyber arm replacing your left arm.  Uses 4 of the 6 points in the left arm; +1 Strength, +1 Dexterity; absorbs damage at quality 85%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Advanced cyber arm (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 4.  A advanced cyber arm replacing your right arm.  Uses 4 of the 6 points in the right arm; +1 Strength, +1 Dexterity; absorbs damage at quality 85%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Advanced cyber leg (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 6.  A advanced cyber leg replacing your left leg.  Uses 6 of the 10 points in the left leg; +1 Dexterity, +1 Strength; absorbs damage at quality 85%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Advanced cyber leg (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_r 6.  A advanced cyber leg replacing your right leg.  Uses 6 of the 10 points in the right leg; +1 Dexterity, +1 Strength; absorbs damage at quality 85%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Aero-Evaporator - toggled implant.  Power: running cost 60 J.  Uses slots: torso 5.  This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which slowly trickles directly into your blood stream.  It may fail in very dry environments.

Air Filtration System - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 5, mouth 1.  Surgically implanted in your trachea is an advanced filtration system.  If toxins or airborne diseases find their way into your windpipe, the filter will attempt to remove them.

Alarm System - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 1 J.  Power: running cost 1 J.  Power: trigger cost 5 J.  Uses slots: torso 2, head 1.  A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert you.  This is very useful during sleep, or if you suspect a cloaked pursuer.

Anti-Glare Compensators - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  Your eyes have quick-reacting transition lenses surgically installed over them.  They negate glare penalties, partially protect you from bright flashes, and protect your eyes when welding.

Artificial Night Generator - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 9 kJ.  Power: running cost 9 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 16.  When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 2 tile radius through destructive interference.

AudioVox - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 3, mouth 2.  Hailing from a world choked with neon smog, and appreciated by Exodii artists, the AudioVox implant allows you to change, remodulate, and even autotune your voice.  It also causes vocalizations /(such as shouts and singing/) to be much louder.  It consists of an electronic voice box, synthetic larynx and multiple speakers implanted throughout your throat.

Autonomous Surgical Scalpels - toggled implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 2, arm_l 2.  A system of surgical grade scalpels is implanted in your forearms, extending from just above your wrists.  They allow you to make automated precise cuts and can also be used as a high-quality butchering tool.

Basic cyber arm (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 5.  A basic cyber arm replacing your left arm.  Uses 5 of the 6 points in the left arm; +1 Strength; absorbs damage at quality 70%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Basic cyber arm (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 5.  A basic cyber arm replacing your right arm.  Uses 5 of the 6 points in the right arm; +1 Strength; absorbs damage at quality 70%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Basic cyber leg (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 8.  A basic cyber leg replacing your left leg.  Uses 8 of the 10 points in the left leg; +1 Dexterity; absorbs damage at quality 70%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Basic cyber leg (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_r 8.  A basic cyber leg replacing your right leg.  Uses 8 of the 10 points in the right leg; +1 Dexterity; absorbs damage at quality 70%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Battery System - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 20.  You have a battery draining attachment, and thus can make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.  Use bionic menu to drain charge from a battery.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

Bionic Claws - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 25 J.  Uses slots: hand_l 4, hand_r 4.  Vicious claws have been surgically installed inside your fingers, allowing you to extend and retract them at the cost of a small amount of power.  These do considerable cutting damage, but prevent you from holding anything else while extended.

Bionic Nostril - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 2, mouth 1.  You're really not sure how the CBM ended up in your nose, but no matter how it got there this badly misplaced bionic makes it difficult to breathe.  Increases mouth encumbrance by ten.

Bionic Short Circuit - passive implant.  Power: trigger cost 25 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 1, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, leg_l 3, leg_r 3.  A poorly-wired bionic which fails to serve its intended purpose, this malfunctioning device periodically short-circuits, causing systemic muscle tremors.
Bionic Visual Impairment - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  Due to a badly misplaced dielectric stylette, you are now suffering from mild optic neuropathy.  Increases eye encumbrance by ten.

Bionic-Induced Deformity - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 4, mouth 1.  A combination of poor surgical installation and unpleasant scarring has lead to the malfunctioning bionic catastrophe you call your face.  People who mind that you look like a dime-store Frankenstein will react poorly to your appearance.

Blood Analysis - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 100 J.  Uses slots: torso 4.  Small sensors have been surgically implanted in your heart, allowing you to analyze your blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.

Blood Filter - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 600 J.  Uses slots: torso 5.  A filtration system near your heart allows you to actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs.  It will have limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in your system will be affected.

Cable Charger System - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 7.  You have a complex port surgically mounted above your hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a power source via jumper cable.
Calorie Tracker - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 1.  A module implanted in your body measures your calorie intake and expenditure at all times.
Cerebral Booster - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 6.  Your brain has been enhanced with bionic coprocessors, giving you a +2 bonus to intelligence.

Chain Lightning - activated implant.  Uses slots: torso 16, arm_l 4.  Your body is equipped with a chain lightning generator, allowing you to emit a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake, jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.

Cloaking System - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 30 kJ.  Power: running cost 30 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 8, head 2, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, hand_l 1, hand_r 1, leg_l 4, leg_r 4, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  This high-power system uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make you blend into your background, rendering you fully invisible to normal vision.  However, you may be detected by infrared, sonar, etc.

Close Quarters Battle - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 20 J.  Power: running cost 20 J.  Uses slots: head 3.  Bionic processors and databanks, loaded with martial arts combat programs, are surgically integrated into your nervous system.  While active, the CQB module will improve your hand-to-hand combat skills, but prevents you from improving them through combat experience.

Concealed arm gun (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 3.  A power-fed pistol folded inside the left forearm.  Activate it to raise the gun; it fires bullets using bionic power.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the arm.

Concealed arm gun (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 3.  A power-fed pistol folded inside the right forearm.  Activate it to raise the gun; it fires bullets using bionic power.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the arm.
Cortical coprocessor - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 2.  Cortical coprocessor: a cranial implant that gives +1 Intelligence.  Uses 2 of the 8 points in the head.
Cortical coprocessor II - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3.  Cortical coprocessor II: a cranial implant that gives +2 Intelligence.  Uses 3 of the 8 points in the head.
Cortical coprocessor III - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 4.  Cortical coprocessor III: a cranial implant that gives +3 Intelligence.  Uses 4 of the 8 points in the head.
Cranial Flashlight - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 2 J.  Power: running cost 2 J.  Uses slots: head 1.  Surgically mounted between your eyes is a small but powerful LED flashlight.
Cyberbrain Mk I - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3.  A cyberbrain interfaced with your nervous system.  Control Value limit 4.  Required to run nanohacks.

Cyberstomach - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 4.  A synthetic stomach that turns food into bionic power (toggle it on) and lets you eat cyber rations, which an ordinary stomach cannot digest.  Uses 4 of the 24 points in the torso.
Diamond Cornea - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  Your vision is greatly enhanced, giving you a +2 bonus to perception.

Dielectric Capacitance System - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 5 J.  Power: running cost 5 J.  Uses slots: torso 8, head 2, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, hand_l 1, hand_r 1, leg_l 3, leg_r 3, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  Throughout your body lies a network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors which can be charged with bionic power to temporarily protect you from external electrical discharge.

Directional EMP - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 50 kJ.  Uses slots: arm_l 6, hand_l 1.  Surgically mounted in your left arm and the palm of your left hand are small parabolic EMP field generators.  You may use power to fire a wide but short-ranged blast that will disable electronics and robots.

Electrical Discharge - passive implant.  Power: trigger cost 10 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 6.  A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges electricity through your body, causing pain and brief paralysis but no damage.
Electrical Drain - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 2.  A malfunctioning bionic.  It doesn't perform any useful function, but will occasionally draw power from your batteries.
Electromagnetic Leak - passive implant.  Adds -25 kJ of power capacity.  A broken implant that sends electromagnetic impulses that reduce other implants capacity to store charge.

Electromagnetic Unit - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 15 kJ.  Uses slots: arm_l 9.  Surgically embedded in your left arm is a powerful electromagnet, allowing you to use your own strength to pull all nearby magnetic objects towards you.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.

Electroshock Unit - toggled implant.  Power: trigger cost 2 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 8, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, hand_l 1, hand_r 1.  While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock your opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.

Elite cyber arm (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 3.  A elite cyber arm replacing your left arm.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the left arm; +2 Strength, +1 Dexterity; absorbs damage at quality 100%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Elite cyber arm (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 3.  A elite cyber arm replacing your right arm.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the right arm; +2 Strength, +1 Dexterity; absorbs damage at quality 100%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Elite cyber leg (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 5.  A elite cyber leg replacing your left leg.  Uses 5 of the 10 points in the left leg; +2 Dexterity, +1 Strength; absorbs damage at quality 100%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Elite cyber leg (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_r 5.  A elite cyber leg replacing your right leg.  Uses 5 of the 10 points in the right leg; +2 Dexterity, +1 Strength; absorbs damage at quality 100%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

EMP Projector - activated implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 8, hand_r 2.  A ranged EMP generator system is implanted in your right arm and the palm of your right hand.  The system fires precise, single-target pulses that require time to aim.  Extremely effective against electronic targets but mostly useless otherwise.

Endocrine Enervator - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 2.  Through a combination of psychochemical manipulation and old fashioned electrical nerve stimulation, this malfunctioning bionic alters your brain chemistry in such a way as to cause sleepiness.  You will find yourself tiring a bit faster than before.

Enhanced Hearing - toggled implant.  Uses slots: head 2.  When this bionic is active, your hearing will be drastically improved, allowing you to hear ten times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage your hearing.

Enhanced Memory Banks - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 2 J.  Power: running cost 2 J.  Power: trigger cost 25 J.  Uses slots: head 3.  Your memory has been enhanced with small quantum storage drives.  While active, you learn - both through reading and practice - more quickly.  Additionally, you forget skills you've learned slower.
Ethanol Burner - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 20.  You burn alcohol as fuel in an extremely efficient reaction.

Expanded Digestive System - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 20.  You have been outfitted with three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines.  Not only can you extract much more nutrition from food, but you are highly resistant to foodborne illness, and can sometimes eat rotten food.

Facial Distortion - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3, mouth 1.  Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, you are capable of altering your facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.
Finger Lighter - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 1500 J.  Uses slots: hand_l 1.  The index finger of your left hand has a fire starter that can extend from the tip.

Finger-Mounted Laser - activated implant.  Uses slots: hand_r 1.  One of your fingers has a small high-powered laser surgically embedded in it.  This long range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.

Fingerhack - toggled implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 1.  One of your fingers has an electrohack surgically embedded in it; an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like (but not computers).  Skill in computers is important, and a failed use may damage your circuits.

Fingerpick - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 50 J.  Uses slots: hand_l 2.  One of your fingers has an electronic lockpick surgically embedded in it.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.

Fingertip Razors - passive implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 1, hand_r 1.  You possess razor-sharp claws underneath your fingernails that do a small amount of unarmed slashing damage whenever your fingertips are uncovered.

Flashbang Generator - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 10 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 18, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, leg_l 3, leg_r 3.  Light emitting diodes surgically integrated into your skin can release a flash comparable to a flashbang grenade, blinding nearby enemies.  Speakers integrated into your body mimic the loud sound, deafening those nearby.

Gasoline Fuel Cell - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 8.  A small gasoline fuel cell fixed to your scapula.  Despite its limited energy output compared to other fuel cells, this device still produces a significant amount of heat dissipated through a heat exhaust protruding from your back.  A diffuse network of bio-plastic bladders has been meshed with your circulatory system and serves as a fuel tank.

Glowy Thing - passive implant.  Power: trigger cost 1 kJ.  You don't think that capacitor is *meant* to glow, but it does, and usually at bad times.  A malfunctioning bionic randomly turns on and off, causing you to glow and making you visible in the dark without improving how much you can see in the slightest.

Heat Drain - toggled implant.  Power: trigger cost 3 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 6, head 3, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, hand_l 1, hand_r 1, leg_l 5, leg_r 5, foot_l 2, foot_r 2.  While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage, and increasing your power reserves slightly.

Heavy dermal plating (head) - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the head: +8 bullet armor and +4 against blows and blades.  Uses 3 of the 8 points in the head; only one plating fits per body part.

Heavy dermal plating (left arm) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 3.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the left arm: +8 bullet armor and +4 against blows and blades.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the left arm; only one plating fits per body part.

Heavy dermal plating (left leg) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 5.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the left leg: +8 bullet armor and +4 against blows and blades.  Uses 5 of the 10 points in the left leg; only one plating fits per body part.

Heavy dermal plating (right arm) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 3.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the right arm: +8 bullet armor and +4 against blows and blades.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the right arm; only one plating fits per body part.

Heavy dermal plating (right leg) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_r 5.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the right leg: +8 bullet armor and +4 against blows and blades.  Uses 5 of the 10 points in the right leg; only one plating fits per body part.

Heavy dermal plating (torso) - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 8.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the torso: +11 bullet armor and +5 against blows and blades.  Uses 8 of the 24 points in the torso; only one plating fits per body part.

Hydraulic Muscles - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 10 kJ.  Power: running cost 10 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 10, arm_l 8, arm_r 8, leg_l 10, leg_r 10.  While activated, your muscles will be greatly enhanced, increasing your strength by 20.

Implanted Night Vision - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 10 J.  Power: running cost 10 J.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  When active, this bionic will amplify existing light, allowing you to see in the dark.
Infolink - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 2.  A compact communications device has been built into your ears, enabling you to communicate over radio waves.

Infrared Vision - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 5 J.  Power: running cost 5 J.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  Your range of vision extends into the infrared, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark or through smoke.

Integrated AR System - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  Extremely thin lenses provide user with augmented reality overlay allowing the user to zoom, and it displays handy information about local topology.

Integrated Circuitry Toolset - passive implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 2, hand_r 2.  Your fingers and arms have been implanted a soldering iron, a multimeter, and a set of small screwdrivers, providing all the tools required for working with bench-scale electrical circuits.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.

Integrated Dosimeter - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 100 J.  Uses slots: torso 2, head 1, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 1, leg_r 1.  Small radiation sensors have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to analyze your level of absorbed radiation.  They will also alert you whenever exposed to environmental radiation.

Integrated Multimeter - passive implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 1, hand_r 1.  Your fingers and arms have been implanted with retractable electrical probes connected to a multimeter embedded in your arm, allowing you to measure electrical voltage, resistance, and current by touch.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.

Integrated Multitool - passive implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 2, hand_r 2, arm_l 2, arm_r 2.  Surgically implanted in your hands and forearms is a set of compact tools and a welder that runs off your internal power banks.

Internal Chronometer - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 1.  You have been equipped with an internal atomic clock, ensuring that you will always know the current time.  Additionally, it includes a silent alarm clock function.

Internal Climate Control - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 100 J.  Power: running cost 100 J.  Uses slots: torso 8, head 2, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, hand_l 1, hand_r 1, leg_l 3, leg_r 3, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  Throughout your body lies a network of thermal piping, which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures when activated.

Intravenous Needletip - passive implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 1.  The flesh of the inside of your middle finger has been replaced with a tube leading into your arteries, with a retractable needle extending out of the tip of the finger when clenched.  This lets you pump intravenous drugs like morphine directly into your bloodstream without needing to carry a syringe.

Itchy Metal Thing - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 3, head 2.  A bionic of some sort, so badly installed that you cannot even tell what it was originally supposed to be.  Sometimes it itches horribly.

Joint Servo - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 5 J.  Power: trigger cost 35 J.  Uses slots: leg_l 12, leg_r 12.  Your leg joints have been equipped with servomotors that provide power-assisted movement.  Movement takes less effort when this bionic is online.  However, when it's offline it will hamper your movement, as you struggle against its moving parts.

Joint Torsion Ratchet - toggled implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 8, arm_r 8, leg_l 12, leg_r 12.  Your joints have been surgically equipped with torsion ratchets that slowly generate power when you move.  Whilst this is toggled, moving will require more effort, though more power will be generated.

Leaky Bionic - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 5.  This botched piece of bionic hardware slowly leaks electrolytic compounds, piezoelectric nanomaterials, and other high-tech contaminants into your bloodstream.  Needless to say, this is not good for your health.

LED Tattoo - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 1 J.  Power: running cost 1 J.  A small LED display just beneath your dermal layer can be illuminated on command to show patterns of your choice at dim or bright luminosity.  It doesn't provide enough light to comfortably read or craft, but it can suffice if you have nothing else.

Leukocyte Breeder System - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 5 J.  Power: running cost 5 J.  Uses slots: torso 10.  You are equipped with bionic stimulators which augment your haematopoiesis system, allowing you to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is supposed to run continuously and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.

Light dermal plating (head) - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 2.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the head: +4 bullet armor and +2 against blows and blades.  Uses 2 of the 8 points in the head; only one plating fits per body part.

Light dermal plating (left arm) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 2.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the left arm: +4 bullet armor and +2 against blows and blades.  Uses 2 of the 6 points in the left arm; only one plating fits per body part.

Light dermal plating (left leg) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 3.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the left leg: +4 bullet armor and +2 against blows and blades.  Uses 3 of the 10 points in the left leg; only one plating fits per body part.

Light dermal plating (right arm) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 2.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the right arm: +4 bullet armor and +2 against blows and blades.  Uses 2 of the 6 points in the right arm; only one plating fits per body part.

Light dermal plating (right leg) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_r 3.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the right leg: +4 bullet armor and +2 against blows and blades.  Uses 3 of the 10 points in the right leg; only one plating fits per body part.

Light dermal plating (torso) - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 4.  Plates of ceramic and polymer under the skin of the torso: +6 bullet armor and +3 against blows and blades.  Uses 4 of the 24 points in the torso; only one plating fits per body part.
Master spine - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 6.  A full-stack spinal implant: +2 Strength, +2 Dexterity and +2 Intelligence.  Uses the 6 spine points of the torso; only one spine implant fits.

Medical prosthetic arm (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 6.  A medical prosthetic arm replacing your left arm.  Uses 6 of the 6 points in the left arm (a complete replacement: the limb is fully cyberized); no stat bonus; absorbs damage at quality 50%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Medical prosthetic arm (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 6.  A medical prosthetic arm replacing your right arm.  Uses 6 of the 6 points in the right arm (a complete replacement: the limb is fully cyberized); no stat bonus; absorbs damage at quality 50%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Medical prosthetic leg (left) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 10.  A medical prosthetic leg replacing your left leg.  Uses 10 of the 10 points in the left leg (a complete replacement: the limb is fully cyberized); no stat bonus; absorbs damage at quality 50%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Medical prosthetic leg (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_r 10.  A medical prosthetic leg replacing your right leg.  Uses 10 of the 10 points in the right leg (a complete replacement: the limb is fully cyberized); no stat bonus; absorbs damage at quality 50%.  Installing it rebuilds the limb.

Metabolic Interchange - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 20.  Your digestive system and power supply are interconnected; bionic energy is replenished by burning calories.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

Monomolecular Blade - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 50 J.  Uses slots: arm_r 7, hand_r 1.  A deadly foot-long blade made of advanced material now resides inside your forearm, capable of being extended through the back of your wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent you from holding anything else while extended.

Motor Control Overstimulator - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3.  One piezoelectric solenoid surgically installed backwards, two crossed wires, and four burned-out capacitors later you started falling on your face and writhing around at the least convenient times.  This incorrectly-configured bionic periodically stuns you for a short duration.

Muscle Augmentation - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 6, arm_l 4, arm_r 4, leg_l 8, leg_r 8.  Your muscular system has been surgically enhanced with myomer fibers, giving you a +2 bonus to strength.
Myomer spine I - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 6.  Myomer spine I: a spinal implant that gives +1 Strength.  Uses the 6 spine points of the torso; only one spine implant fits.
Myomer spine II - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 6.  Myomer spine II: a spinal implant that gives +2 Strength.  Uses the 6 spine points of the torso; only one spine implant fits.
Myomer spine III - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 6.  Myomer spine III: a spinal implant that gives +3 Strength.  Uses the 6 spine points of the torso; only one spine implant fits.
Neural lace - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 5.  Neural lace: a cranial implant that gives +2 Intelligence, +2 Perception.  Uses 5 of the 8 points in the head.
Neural spine I - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 6.  Neural spine I: a spinal implant that gives +1 Intelligence.  Uses the 6 spine points of the torso; only one spine implant fits.
Neural spine II - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 6.  Neural spine II: a spinal implant that gives +2 Intelligence.  Uses the 6 spine points of the torso; only one spine implant fits.
Neural spine III - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 6.  Neural spine III: a spinal implant that gives +3 Intelligence.  Uses the 6 spine points of the torso; only one spine implant fits.
Nictitating Membrane - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  Your eyes are equipped with thin membranes that cover your eyes while underwater, negating any vision penalties.
Noisemaker - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 4, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 1, leg_r 1.  A malfunctioning bionic.  It will occasionally emit a loud burst of noise.

Offensive Defense System - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 10 J.  Power: running cost 10 J.  Power: trigger cost 400 J.  Uses slots: torso 10, head 1, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 2, leg_r 2.  A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  This field does not deflect attacks, but rather delivers a strong shock, damaging unarmed attackers and those with a conductive weapon.
Oil Generator - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 20.  Slowly generates bionic power out of kerosene or motor oil.

Olfactory Mask - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 1.  Power: running cost 1.  Uses slots: torso 3, head 1, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 1, leg_r 1.  While this system is powered, your body will produce very little odor, making it nearly impossible for creatures to track you by scent.
Optical Dampers - toggled implant.  A pair of lenses surgically installed over your eyes that can be tinted to block out incoming light.

Power Overload - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 3, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 2, leg_r 2.  Damaged power circuits cause short-circuiting inside your muscles when your batteries are above 75% capacity, causing greatly reduced strength.  This has no effect if you have no internal batteries.

Power Storage - passive implant.  Adds 100 kJ of power capacity.  A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 100 kJ.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  You will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.
Power Storage Mk. II - passive implant.  Adds 250 kJ of power capacity.  A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 250 kJ.

Probability Travel - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 3 J.  Power: running cost 3 J.  Power: trigger cost 250 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 20, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, leg_l 3, leg_r 3, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  Increases your body's wavelength, allowing you to quantum tunnel through walls, reappearing on the other side.  Power drain in standby is minimal, but each tile tunneled through costs 250 bionic power.

Protective Lenses - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  Your eye sockets have been surgically sealed with highly protective mirrored lenses and your tear ducts have been re-routed to your mouth.  When you cry, you must spit out or swallow your tears.

Radiation Scrubber System - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 4500 J.  Uses slots: torso 5, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 2, leg_r 2.  A system of advanced piezomechanical blood filters have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to purge yourself of absorbed radiation at the cost of some bionic power.
Radioactive Leak - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 4.  This damaged CBM occasionally leaks radiation.
Recoil Compensators - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 4, arm_r 4, hand_l 2, hand_r 2.  Reactive shock absorbers installed in your wrists and elbows which greatly reduce felt recoil.

Recycler Unit - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 15.  Your digestive system has been outfitted with a series of filters and processors, allowing you to reclaim waste liquid and, to a lesser degree, nutrients.  The net effect is a greatly reduced need to eat and drink.
Reflex Accelerator - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 4, leg_l 2, leg_r 2.  Spinal reflex boosters.  +2 Dexterity and a 20% chance to sidestep any incoming bullet.
Reflex spine I - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 6.  Reflex spine I: a spinal implant that gives +1 Dexterity.  Uses the 6 spine points of the torso; only one spine implant fits.
Reflex spine II - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 6.  Reflex spine II: a spinal implant that gives +2 Dexterity.  Uses the 6 spine points of the torso; only one spine implant fits.
Reflex spine III - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 6.  Reflex spine III: a spinal implant that gives +3 Dexterity.  Uses the 6 spine points of the torso; only one spine implant fits.
Remote Controller - toggled implant.  Power: running cost 1.  Uses slots: head 2.  A small module connected to your brain allows you to interface with nearby devices with wireless capabilities.

Repair Nanobots - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 80 J.  Power: running cost 40 J.  Uses slots: torso 12.  Inside your body is a fleet of tiny dormant robots.  While activated they will flit about your body, repairing damage at 1 HP per minute and stopping bleeding at the cost of extra power and stored calories.  No power is consumed if there is nothing to heal.

Respirator - toggled implant.  Power: trigger cost 25 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 8, head 2, mouth 2.  A complex respiration augmentation system.  Improves respiration ability in air and allows breathing water.  Will automatically activate when drowning.  Turn on to recharge stamina faster, at moderate power cost.  Asthmatics may also use it to stop asthma attacks.

Self-Locking Thumbs - passive implant.  Uses slots: hand_l 1, hand_r 1.  Self-locking thumbs hold tight (even when you really don't want them to) and don't let go (even when you'd rather they did).  Increases hand encumbrance by ten, while failing to improve your ability to hold objects whatsoever.
Sensor array - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 2.  Sensor array: a cranial implant that gives +1 Perception.  Uses 2 of the 8 points in the head.
Sensor array II - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3.  Sensor array II: a cranial implant that gives +2 Perception.  Uses 3 of the 8 points in the head.
Sensor array III - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 4.  Sensor array III: a cranial implant that gives +3 Perception.  Uses 4 of the 8 points in the head.

Sensory Dulling - toggled implant.  Power: trigger cost 2 kJ.  Uses slots: head 2.  Your nervous system is wired to allow you to inhibit the signals of pain, allowing you to dull your senses at will.  However, the use of this system may cause delayed reaction time and drowsiness.

Shockwave Generator - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 250.  Uses slots: torso 20.  You generate a powerful shockwave, knocking back all nearby creatures.  Targets are stunned briefly, take damage and additional stun upon impact with impassable terrain, and knockback any creatures they collide with.
Shotgun Arm - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 50 J.  Uses slots: arm_l 12.  Concealed in your left arm is a single shot 12 gauge shotgun.  Activate the bionic to fire and reload the shotgun.
Silent servos - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 3, leg_r 3.  Damped joint servos in both legs: your footsteps make far less noise.  Uses 3 points in each leg.
Sleep Mode Shutdown - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 1.  For better or worse, this CBM suppresses stimuli while asleep, preventing you from waking up until the end of your natural sleep cycle.

Sonic Resonator - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 100.  Uses slots: torso 15, head 1, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, leg_l 4, leg_r 4.  Your entire body may resonate at very high power, creating a short-range shockwave.  While it will not do much damage to creatures, solid objects such as walls and doors will be damaged.

Soporific Induction - toggled implant.  Uses slots: head 1.  An electrode has been implanted into your brain's ventrolateral preoptic nucleus.  It turns on whenever you're trying to fall asleep, creating an artificial but effective sensation of sleepiness.
Sound Dampeners - toggled implant.  When this bionic is active, you can block hearing completely.

Squeaky Ankles - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 3, leg_r 3.  In a cruel twist of fate, a poorly executed CBM surgery has given you a pair of useless bionics which make squeaking noises when you walk.

Subaquatic Navigation System - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 1 J.  Power: trigger cost 5 J.  Uses slots: head 1.  While active, a tiny device in your inner ear periodically generates ultrasonic pulses which aid in navigation, provided you are underwater and able to hear.

Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Arms - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_l 4, arm_r 4, hand_l 1, hand_r 1.  An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your arms and hands, protecting them from physical trauma.

Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Head - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3, mouth 1.  An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your head and jaw region, protecting your skull from physical trauma.

Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Legs - passive implant.  Uses slots: leg_l 6, leg_r 6, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your legs and feet, protecting them from physical trauma.
Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Torso - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 10.  An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your torso, protecting it from physical trauma.

Subdermal Carbon Filament - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 6, head 2, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, leg_l 3, leg_r 3, foot_l 1, foot_r 1, hand_l 1, hand_r 1, mouth 1.  Lying just beneath your skin is a thin armor made of carbon nanotubes.  This has no impact on blunt trauma but will protect you against deep cuts.
Super Stun Gun - activated implant.  Uses slots: hand_r 3.  You have a powerful stun gun built into your hand.  Activate to zap an adjacent enemy.

Synaptic Accelerator - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 8, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, hand_l 1, hand_r 1, leg_l 6, leg_r 6, foot_l 2, foot_r 2.  Your nervous system has been enhanced with bionic stimulators, giving you a 10% boost to your speed.

Synaptic Regeneration System - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 0.  Power: running cost 1 kJ.  Uses slots: head 1, torso 1.  An electromagnetic stimulator has been surgically implanted on the back of your head and along your spine, continually draining power.  As long as it's active, you will not suffer from sleep deprivation, although you may still feel sleepy; and if you're sleep deprived already, it will gradually reduce the symptoms of lacking sleep.

Synthetic Lungs - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 3 J.  Power: running cost 3 J.  Power: trigger cost 3 J.  Uses slots: torso 5.  You have highly efficient artificial lungs which greatly increase your oxygen intake.  If they are not powered you will suffocate, and they weaken your immune system somewhat.

Targeting System - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, hand_l 1, hand_r 1.  Your eyes are surgically equipped with range finders, and their movement is synced with that of your arms, to a degree.  Shots you fire will be much more accurate, particularly at long range.

Taste Fouler - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 1, mouth 1.  A malfunctioning processor haphazardly interfaced with your taste receptors has given everything you consume a horrid bitter taste.  Food and drink will severely harm your morale.

Taste Modifier - toggled implant.  Uses slots: head 1, mouth 1.  A set of highly sensitive sensors is installed in your mouth, and a small yet sophisticated analyzer is installed in the cavity of your skull.  The active bionic will nullify the taste of all comestibles with negative enjoyment value at the cost of draining bionic power.

Teleportation Unit - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 250.  Uses slots: torso 16, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, leg_l 4, leg_r 4.  This highly experimental unit folds space over short distances, instantly transporting your body up to 25 feet at the cost of much power.  Note that prolonged or frequent use may have dangerous side effects.

Telescopic Eyes - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 2.  Much of the material in your inner eye has been surgically removed and replaced with an array of high-powered, auto-focusing lenses.  They function as integrated binoculars, letting you see much farther than before, and any vision problems you might have had are now gone.

Terranian Sonar - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 200 J.  Power: running cost 200 J.  Uses slots: foot_l 3, foot_r 3.  Your feet are equipped with precision sonar equipment, allowing you to detect the movements of creatures below the ground, buried traps, and unstable terrain.

Thermal Dissipation - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 1 kJ.  Power: running cost 1 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 10, head 2, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, hand_l 1, hand_r 1, leg_l 3, leg_r 3, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  Powerful heatsinks and supermaterials are surgically woven into your flesh.  While powered, this system will prevent heat damage up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.  Note that this does not affect your internal temperature.
Threat Predictor - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 2, head 3.  Optical threat prediction.  +2 Perception and a 15% chance to step out of the line of fire.

Throwing Assist - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1, arm_l 2, arm_r 2, hand_l 2, hand_r 2.  Taken from a world that embraced cybernetics in their sports, this CBM links the eyes to a series of nerve stimulators along the arms and hands.  The result is a significant increase to throwing accuracy, and it turns out it works great with fragmentation grenades.

Time Dilation - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 50.  Uses slots: torso 12, head 3, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, hand_l 1, hand_r 1, leg_l 4, leg_r 4, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  At the cost of all stored bionic power, you may increase your body speed and reactions dramatically, essentially freezing time.  You are still delicate, however, and violent or rapid movements may damage you due to friction.

Titanium Skeletal Bracing - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 8, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, leg_l 3, leg_r 3.  Titanium bracing has been installed onto your elbows, knees, and spine, making them far better at handling strain.  Your carrying capacity is increased by 20 kilograms, or about 44 pounds, and you receive slightly less bashing damage to your arms, legs and torso.

Ultrabright Flashlight - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 15 J.  Power: running cost 15 J.  You can greatly intensify the power of your bionic flashlight to be much brighter at a much higher power cost.

Uncanny Dodge - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 6 J.  Power: running cost 6 J.  Power: trigger cost 75 kJ.  Uses slots: torso 12, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, leg_l 5, leg_r 5, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  Your nervous system has been augmented with bionic processors, allowing you to dodge attacks beyond normal human capability.

Unified Power System - toggled implant.  Uses slots: torso 5.  You have a Unified Power System wired into your power banks.  Objects that run on a UPS can now draw directly from your bionic power supply.
Visual Disruptor - passive implant.  Uses slots: eyes 1.  A malfunctioning bionic which causes occasional visual distortion and pixelation.

Voice Remodulator - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 2, mouth 1.  You will likely spend the rest of your days serving as a walking testament to why you don't opt for the Autodoc's 'Cyborg Identity Package'.  A remodulator unit jammed down your throat has given you a creepy robot voice.

Water Extraction Unit - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 20 kJ.  Uses slots: arm_l 3, hand_l 1.  Nanotubes surgically embedded in the palm of your hand will pump any available fluid out of a dead body, cleanse it of impurities and convert it into drinkable water.  You must, however, have a container to store the water in.

WearMan - toggled implant.  Power: activation cost 1 J.  Power: running cost 1 J.  Uses slots: head 1.  Surgically implanted into your skull near the eardrums are two speakers, as well as a small port behind the left earlobe.  They can pick up local radio waves and play downloaded music in concert hall quality.  It came pre-installed with "Rubik's Mickse".

Weather Reader - activated implant.  Power: activation cost 10 J.  Uses slots: torso 1, head 1.  A multitude of scientific instruments and sensors collect environmental data.  The data is compiled and presented as a simple readout of the current weather.  It also passively tells you the local air temperature.

Wire-Induced Stiffness - passive implant.  Uses slots: torso 2, arm_l 1, arm_r 1, leg_l 1, leg_r 1, foot_l 1, foot_r 1.  Improperly installed wires cause a physical stiffness in most of your body, causing increased encumbrance.

Wired Reflexes - passive implant.  Uses slots: head 3, torso 6, arm_l 3, arm_r 3, leg_l 7, leg_r 7.  Your reaction time has been greatly enhanced with bionic nerve stimulators, giving you a +2 bonus to dexterity.
Wrist blade (right) - passive implant.  Uses slots: arm_r 3.  A monomolecular blade that slides out of the right wrist.  Uses 3 of the 6 points in the arm.
then.title: Implant Status

description: A wrist display wired to your implants.  Use it to list every implant you have installed, with its type, power cost, body slots and effects.
